TipTexts.SourceString: 是局内禁制机动队四队的成员，其中两位，之前新西里安的行动中应该跟你打过照面。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: They're from ETD-4. You probably ran into two of them in the New Helios op.

TipTexts.SourceString: 歧骸变得厉害起来了，不过完全不是我们的对手！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: The oddities are getting tougher, but still no match for us!

TipTexts.SourceString: 还有还有，我们听到了奇怪的声音，像是在说些什么的样子，现在听得越来越清楚了！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Oh, and! We heard some voices, mumbling… It's getting clearer now!

TipTexts.SourceString: 可听起来……不像什么好话……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: But it sounds… kinda ominous…

TipTexts.SourceString: 未来大家还会经常联络。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I'm sure we'll keep in touch.

TipTexts.SourceString: 话先说在前面，我可不是特意来帮你的！只是这家伙也正好挡了我的路！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Let me make this clear, I'm not here to help! This one was just in my way too!
Hey! Need any help?

TipTexts.SourceString: 嚯，你怎么被这种家伙缠上了？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Whoa, how did you get tangled up with someone like this?
Don't you fall down here!
Hey, snap out of it!
It's not over!

TipTexts.SourceString: 下次要是还有这种事，喊我来就行。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Just call me if this happens again.
That felt great!
I'm outta here!

TipTexts.SourceString: 此次介入仅为我的个人行动，与E.T.D无关。只是来帮朋友处理麻烦。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: This intervention has nothing to do with ETD. I acted alone. Just helping a friend.
Need a hand?

TipTexts.SourceString: 维护秩序是我的职责所在。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: My duty is to maintain order.
Time to strike.
Ready to support.
Prepared to suppress.

TipTexts.SourceString: 处理完毕。四队还有其他工作，我先告辞了。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: All clear. Squad 4 has other tasks to attend to. I'll take my leave.
Pleasure working with you.
Until next time.

TipTexts.SourceString: 不要害怕，柯林斯一代目前来救场！我会保护好你的！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Fear not, for the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis is here to save the day!
I'll watch your back!

TipTexts.SourceString: 天空一声巨响，老大闪亮登场！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Boom, swoosh, pow! It's the Ichi-daime!
The Ichi-daime got you covered!
Don't give up!

TipTexts.SourceString: 让这家伙看看咱们的厉害！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Show them what we're made of!

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼，解决了！柯林斯家族，今天也在泯除邪恶！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: All done! The Coluccis have nullified evil for another day!
We won! Happy working with you!

TipTexts.SourceString: 不用道谢，多多宣传柯林斯的威名就行了！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: No need to thank me, just spread the word about the Coluccis!

TipTexts.SourceString: 可可，竟然在进行这么危险的作战……我也要来帮忙！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Coco, this fight is dangerous… I have to help!
Coco, I'm here to help!

TipTexts.SourceString: 来吧，我们一起大干一场~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Together, our fight will be legendary!
Coco, don't give up!
I'm here to help!
Coco, pull yourself together!

TipTexts.SourceString: 薄荷队员，圆满完成任务！得找个地方好好睡一觉了。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Mint, mission complete! Now I need to get some good sleep.

TipTexts.SourceString: 哼哼，我的表现还不错吧~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Heheh, I did pretty well, didn't I?

TipTexts.SourceString: 看来这家伙已经被解决了，那我走了哦！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Looks like this one's been taken care of. I'm heading out!

TipTexts.SourceString: 哈尼娅·克雷斯维尔，回应你的呼唤！这样的台词果然很帅啊！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Haniel Cresswell, answering your call…! That was a great line!

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师，让我们并肩作战吧！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's fight side by side!

TipTexts.SourceString: 斯特利王牌快递员驾到！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Sterry's ace delivery girl has arrived!
This is the power of friendship!

TipTexts.SourceString: 我们的使命还没有完成……还不能倒下！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Our mission isn't over yet… We can't fall down here!
Haniel, charging you up!

TipTexts.SourceString: 怎么样，哈尼娅有帮上忙吧？这下我们的羁绊又加深啦！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I did my part! Our bond is growing stronger!

TipTexts.SourceString: 呜哇，派件要超时了，我得赶紧走了……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Oh no, running late… gotta do my next delivery!

TipTexts.SourceString: 走啦，以后也可以再召唤我帮忙！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Off I go! You can always call me for help!

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师，遇到麻烦了吗？明白了，我会……尽力帮忙的！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you need help? Got it. I'll… I'll do my best!
I'll support you as much as I can…!
Let me help too…
Appraiser, hang in there!
There's still hope…!
Appraiser, are you okay?

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼……圆满解决。辛苦了，鉴定师。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Phew… Problem solved. Thank you, Appraiser.
I'm glad everyone's okay…
It's over…

TipTexts.SourceString: 嗨嗨嗨，要帮忙吗？就算你说不需要，我也已经在这里了哦。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Hey there, need a hand? Even if you don't, I'm already here!

TipTexts.SourceString: 找了半天，原来你在这儿啊。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: So this is where you were. I looked everywhere!
Okay! Time for some exercise!
Let's finish this quickly.
Alright, let's do our best!

TipTexts.SourceString: 下手、还可以、再重一点的哦——！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Nice hit… but you can do better than that!

TipTexts.SourceString: 请付我加班费——开玩笑的啦，能帮到你就好。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: You better pay me overtime… Just kidding! I'm happy to help.
This place isn't safe. I'm out!
Phew… that's a wrap!

TipTexts.SourceString: 业务范围外的战斗……帮你一把也无妨。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: This is not my job description… but I don't mind lending you a hand.
I'll assist you in battle.
Looks like you're in trouble.
Things aren't looking great.
Don't give up.
Support in position.

TipTexts.SourceString: 这是我个人立场的帮助，并非委托，因此不收取委托费用。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I won't charge you fees. I'm helping you out of my own volition.
I shall take my leave.
Quest complete.

TipTexts.SourceString: 鄙人相信鉴定师定能战胜这敌人。不过多一份助力，大约能轻松些。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I believe you can win. But it would be easier if you had more help.

TipTexts.SourceString: 或许有我能帮得上忙的地方。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Perhaps I can be of assistance.

TipTexts.SourceString: 单打独斗未免辛苦，我来帮忙。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: It's dangerous to fight alone. Let me help!
You can proceed with confidence.
Defense, in place.
Appraiser, hang in there.
Pull yourself together, Appraiser.

TipTexts.SourceString: 辛苦了。善后工作，交给我就好。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Nice work. Leave the rest to me.
An expected victory.

TipTexts.SourceString: 那么，我就先回伊波恩了。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Well then, I shall return to Eibon.

TipTexts.SourceString: 乖孩子，需要帮忙吗？不要独自面对这份痛苦……也分享给我一些吧。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Cutie, need help? Don't face that pain alone… you can share it with me.
New prey… That's exciting.
Something new to play with.

TipTexts.SourceString: 这就结束了吗？真是不耐用啊~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: It's over already? So weak.
Until next time!
That was fun.

TipTexts.SourceString: 来了来了，怎么这么大阵仗？可不能让我们家招财宝吃了亏！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: What's with all the commotion? I won't let anyone mess with our Precious!

TipTexts.SourceString: 就是你这家伙，在欺负我们招财宝？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: So you're the one bullying our Precious?
This place isn't very safe.

TipTexts.SourceString: 我先回去睡觉了啊。吵吵嚷嚷的，震得我脑壳疼……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I'm going back to sleep. All this noise is giving me a headache…

TipTexts.SourceString: 要跟我一起回伊波恩吗？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Wanna go back to Eibon with me?

TipTexts.SourceString: 比想象中麻烦一些……困了。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: More trouble than I expected… (yawns).
Precious! Pull yourself together!
Hold on a bit… we're almost there.
You okay? Can you still fight?
A commission? I'll help.
Don't worry. I'm here.
I've arrived, Appraiser.
I shall protect you.
Watch enemy movements.
I can't let you get hurt…

TipTexts.SourceString: 解决了。我就先回伊波恩了。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: It's done. I'll return to Eibon.
It's over. Get some rest.

TipTexts.SourceString: 需要帮忙吗？这次出手，我可以不收费哦~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Need some help? I'll do it pro bono this time!
So you're here… interesting.
Appraiser, how have you been?

TipTexts.SourceString: 你要是倒在这儿，我可不好交差啊……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I'll have a lot of paperwork to do if you collapse here…
Dispelling darkness…
Don't fall asleep here!

TipTexts.SourceString: 好啦，问题解决。我来帮你这件事，可别告诉你们店长哟？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Problem solved. Don't tell Hotori I helped, okay?
Favors are the hardest debts to repay!

TipTexts.SourceString: 累了吧，回去记得好好休息哦~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: You must be tired. Get some good rest when you can!

WJ1004.Desc: 安魂曲-偶遇专用-一次性

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，起床，来这里……看见怪物，不喜欢。要帮忙消灭。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, woke up, came here… see monster, don't like. Help take care…

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师，好像很辛苦……安魂曲，来帮忙。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, hard time… Lacrimosa, help.

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，来帮鉴定师的忙……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, help Appraiser…
Appraiser, don't sleep.
Tomato Jelly, for you…
Appraiser… cheer up, keep going.

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，下班……不对，安魂曲刚才……没在上班？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, off work… But Lacrimosa… had no shift?
Later, appraiser.
Won… Lacrimosa, sleepy.

TipTexts.SourceString: 不会让你……伤到鉴定师的。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I won't let you… hurt the Appraiser.
Anomalies… still so annoying…
J-Just in time! Leave this to me.
Stay safe! Y-You got this!
H-Here. Please win…
Get yourself together. I believe in you!
H-Hope I helped… you.

TipTexts.SourceString: 结束了……下次，总、总之，有需要的话还可以找我。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: That's it… I-I'll always be there to help.

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼——待会要……临时通知要加班，我、我先走了……下次见。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Phew—Do you want… Oh, I need to work overtime. See you… next time!

TipTexts.SourceString: 你还好吧，鉴定师？一个人对付这家伙太危险了，让我们也来帮忙吧！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you okay? It's dangerous to fight this one alone. Let us help!

TipTexts.SourceString: 稳住节奏，我们会配合你。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Steady your pace. We'll assist you.

TipTexts.SourceString: 没想到会在这种地方遇到你……还好我就在附近。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Didn't think I'll meet you here… Luckily, I was around.

TipTexts.SourceString: 累了吗，鉴定师？不要太勉强自己，我们一起解决它。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you okay? Don't overwork yourself. We'll do this together.

TipTexts.SourceString: 就快战胜它了，不要放弃！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: We're getting there. Don't give up!

TipTexts.SourceString: 调整呼吸，按你自己的节奏来就好。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Catch your breath and find your own pace.

TipTexts.SourceString: 虽然你可能不愿意麻烦身边的人，但千万别因此让自己受伤呀。以后遇到困难，一定要及时寻求帮助。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: You might not want to trouble others, but don't risk getting hurt. Remember, seek help if you ever need it.

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼，刚才好险啊……还好你平安无事。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Phew, that was close… Glad you're okay.

TipTexts.SourceString: 想起了以前当异象猎人的日子……好怀念啊。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: That reminded me my days as an Anomaly Hunter. Good times.

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，起床，来这里……看见怪物，不喜欢。要帮忙消灭。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, woke up, came here… see monster, don't like. Help take care…

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师，好像很辛苦……安魂曲，来帮忙。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, hard time… Lacrimosa, help.

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，来帮鉴定师的忙……
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, help Appraiser…
Appraiser, don't sleep.
Tomato Jelly, for you…
Appraiser… cheer up, keep going.

TipTexts.SourceString: 安魂曲，下班……不对，安魂曲刚才……没在上班？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, off work… But Lacrimosa… had no shift?
Later, appraiser.
Won… Lacrimosa, sleepy.

TipTexts.SourceString: 我听到了你的召唤，所以来到这里——诶？你说你没喊我吗？
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I got here after hearing your call. Wait, what do you mean you didn't call me?
Hey, don't mind me lending a hand?

TipTexts.SourceString: 这家伙可不好对付，我来搭把手吧！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: This one is pretty tough. Let me help!
Now is the time to go all in!
It's time to attack!
Let's do it!
All done! See you next time!

TipTexts.SourceString: 总感觉意犹未尽啊……不过当然了，还是安全结束战斗最重要！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: That wasn't nearly enough… Well, ending the fight with all limbs is still the priority.

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼，没出什么岔子……那我就先走了！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Phew, that went well… I'll be off!

TipTexts.SourceString: 看来你们正打得火热，不介意的话，就让我也加入吧！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: You're all caught up in the heat of the moment. I'm joining if that's okay.
Stayed focused. I'll cover you.
Appraiser, keep yourself safe.
it's time to go all in!
Give it everything you've got!
Annoying… I'll make it fast!

TipTexts.SourceString: 虽然我不擅长协同作战，不过，跟你合作的感觉还不错。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I'm not great in teamfights, but I enjoyed fighting alongside you.

TipTexts.SourceString: 如果觉得我抢了你的猎物，我可以改天请你吃顿饭。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: If you think I stole your target, I can buy you a meal to compensate.

TipTexts.SourceString: 希望下次遇到你不是在这种地方。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: I hope the next time we meet isn't in a place like this.

TipTexts.SourceString: 哇啊，鉴定师好辛苦的样子……我来帮忙吧~！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Woah, you're having a hard time… Let me help!

TipTexts.SourceString: 好大只的坏家伙！我们一起打倒它吧！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: That's a big bad one! Let's beat it together!

TipTexts.SourceString: 不管你需不需要，总之我来帮忙啦~！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Whether you need me or not, I'm here to help!

TipTexts.SourceString: 用更大的力气，揍扁坏家伙吧~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Beat the baddies with more power!

TipTexts.SourceString: 再用力一点！还要让它更痛、更痛才行呢~
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Hit harder! Give them more pain!
Go, go, go!

TipTexts.SourceString: 哎呀，要迟到了，我先走啦！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Oww, I'm getting late. See ya!
Mission complete. Goodbye!
It's a wrap. See you next time!
Dream a little dream if you get tired!
Kiddos, help the Appraiser!
Icelos, prepare for injection!

1091.Desc: 1.3 灵可-未完成配置-译文key调整中

TipTexts.SourceString: 找到了！鉴定师——这个电波，果然是你没错！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Found you, Appraiser! I knew this frequency was yours!

TipTexts.SourceString: 看得本恶灵手痒了——小鬼！我们上！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: This evil spirit is getting restless! Scamp, let's go!

TipTexts.SourceString: 求助信号已接收，E.T.D六队灵可、开始支援！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Help signal received. Linko from ETD-6 is here to support!

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，这个给你。
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, this is for you.
Hey! Don't strain yourself if you're hurt!

TipTexts.SourceString: 胜利的电波在召唤我们！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: The frequency of victory… is calling out for us!

TipTexts.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，没有受伤吧？唔……没有就好！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, are you hurt? Oh… I'm glad you're okay!

TipTexts.SourceString: 呼~刚才配合得真好，果然我和鉴定师的电波是同频的！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Whew! We work well together. I knew we were in sync!

TipTexts.SourceString: 就算是战斗的时候，鉴定师的电波也一点都不刺耳呢……希望下次也能联机作战！
TipTexts.LocalizedString: Your frequency isn't noisy even when you fight… I hope we can do another co-op!
